messages:
maya: Heads-up — HelioWorks says they were charged twice for their monthly renewal (card + later bank transfer). Customer says both invoices cover the same subscription period. Invoice refs: INV-2026-4521, INV-2026-4522. Account id: acct_87421. Can we triage? :eyes:

carter: On it. Quick Qs — was auto-renew on? Was a PO attached to either payment? Any tax/VAT flags?

maya: Auto-renew was on. No PO in the system at the time of the card charge. Timeline from customer:
- 2026-03-29 17:42 UTC: auto-renew card payment succeeded (pi_3GXpF_card) -> INV-2026-4521 created/applied
- 2026-03-30 09:13 UTC: customer ERP issued bank transfer; they say funds cleared their bank same day. We received a payment webhook later that day and system created INV-2026-4522 and applied the wire.

liam: Can you paste the raw webhook + reconciliation log lines? Need to see dedupe keys.

maya: Pasting sanitized snippets: 

```
{ "event": "payment.succeeded", "source": "bank_transfer", "external_ref": "BR-9987", "account_id": "acct_87421", "amount": 12000, "currency": "GBP", "applied_to": "subscription_334", "period_start": "2026-04-01", "period_end": "2026-04-30" }
`
…and earlier card payment log: 
```
{ "event": "payment.succeeded", "source": "card", "payment_intent": "pi_3GXpF_card", "account_id": "acct_87421", "amount": 12000, "currency": "GBP", "applied_to": "subscription_334", "period_start": "2026-04-01", "period_end": "2026-04-30" }
```
DB query shows both payments linked to different payment_ids but same subscription and period.

carter: Ok — looks like reconciliation created a new invoice when a second external payment arrived because the bank transfer lacked the original payment reference id we use to dedupe (we rely on payment_intent or invoice_id as dedupe keys). Bank transfers often come with different external_ref, so system treated it as a distinct incoming payment.

liam: I can see the bug: the recon pipeline only compares incoming.external_ref OR metadata.payment_intent, not a composite key (account + subscription + period). Short-term fix: update recon rule to check (account_id + subscription + period_start) before creating a new invoice. I'll push a hotfix to the staging rule set and then prod if tests pass.

carter: Meanwhile we need a manual remediation plan for HelioWorks so they aren't double-charged:
1) Refund the card payment (fastest customer-facing option) OR refund the bank transfer if they prefer — they asked for card refund.
2) Void INV-2026-4522 and create a credit note referencing duplicate charge + VAT correction.
3) Reverse ledger entries so month-end revenue isn't duplicated.
4) Confirm with customer when refund initiated and ETA.

finance-bot: GL codes: reverse revenue GL 4000 -> adjustment GL 7001. Credit note template: CN-2026-0049. VAT rate to apply: 20% (UK). Ensure credit note references both invoice ids and original payment ids.

maya: Customer asked for card refund. Carter — can you run the refund flow? Use reason=duplicate_charge, note referencing INV-2026-4522.

carter: Starting refund now. Command: `payments/refund create --payment-id pi_3GXpF_card --amount 12000 --reason duplicate_charge --metadata account=acct_87421,invoice=INV-2026-4521`

refund-bot: Refund initiated -> refund_id rfd_12345, status: pending (provider processing). ETA 3-7 business days. Refund note added to account. :white_check_mark:

liam: I'll scope the recon dedupe change and put a small migration in prod today (low-risk rule change). After that, we should run a backfill job to detect recent duplicates (last 30 days) and flag them for review.

carter: After refund clears, I'll: void INV-2026-4522, create CN-2026-0049 for the duplicated wire, and reverse ledger entries. I'll attach the audit trail here.

maya: Customer notified with refund id and expected timing. They've asked for confirmation when CN shows up so they can close the PO in their ERP.

liam: Note for postmortem: recon should dedupe on (account_id, subscription_id, period_start) and log which key matched. Also add a monitoring alert for >1 payment applied to same subscription/period in 24h.

carter: Adding ticket to billing-ops for manual review and to accounting for credit note issuance. Ticket: BLG-6789.

maya: Thanks all — will follow up after refund clears and CN posted. :pray:
